record.body:
## Description

Both checkouts would still share this store. The five orchestration efforts move to `~/orchestra`; `evidence-layer` stays here. This task is inline because it relocates store files.

## Approach

1. Run `orchestra/project_field.py` on this repo's `.artifacts/project-design.json` so `"project": "affidavit"` becomes `orchestra`. Copy the store tree to `~/orchestra/.artifacts`, then run the same rewrite there if the copy still says `affidavit`. Run `adaptive-artifacts resolve` in each checkout. Do not hand-edit a record file.
2. Move whole record directories (record file, log, and history together) so efforts `dashboard`, `workflow-loop`, `packaging`, `session-analysis`, and `test-suite-speed` exist only in the orchestra store, and `evidence-layer` exists only here. A record with no `payload.effort` moves with the phase or task it belongs to when that side is unambiguous.
3. When a record that stays references a moved id, keep that referenced record in both stores. Do not change the bytes of a record that stays.
4. `adaptive-artifacts validate` in both checkouts. Active goals here: `evidence-layer`. Active goals in orchestra: the five moved efforts.

payload.title: Split effort records across the two stores

record.subject: move-effort-records
